# The Highland Traveler

*The old button-seller from the highlands walks down Stonefang Pass every season, and he has not come. Knox asks you to walk the Western Descent and clear the dark stumps from the switchbacks.*

## Objectives

1. Reach [Western Descent](../maps/western_descent.md)
2. Defeat 20 [Dark Stump](../monsters/dark_stump.md)
